## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2015-02-11: S-1/A files the form-of Exchanges TRA as Exhibit 10.4
- 2015-03-31: Up-C IPO closes; Exchanges TRA executed between GoDaddy Inc. and the continuing Desert Newco LLC unitholders (KKR, Silver Lake, TCV, YAM Special Holdings)
- 2015-04-06: 8-K attaches the executed Exchanges TRA as Exhibit 10.5

#### Coordinated termination

- 2020-07-31: Amendment No. 1 substitutes a fixed Settlement Payment for the future-tax-savings formula in Section 4.1(a); standalone Termination and Release Agreement executed concurrently (8-K Exs. 10.1 and 10.2)
- 2020-08-05: Q2 earnings release discloses $850M aggregate settlement across all five TRAs
- 2020-12-31: $849.8M of the aggregate paid in 2020; residual $0.2M paid in 2021

## Explanation

The Exchanges TRA originated at GoDaddy's March 31, 2015 Up-C IPO and obligated the public company to pay 85% of cumulative net realized tax benefits from Section 754 basis step-ups on future exchanges of Desert Newco LLC units. As the open-ended TRA in the suite of five executed at IPO close, it carried the bulk of the future-payment risk; the four parallel Reorganization TRAs covered a fixed pool of blocker-merger basis. On July 31, 2020 GoDaddy settled all five TRAs together for $850M aggregate, terminating the Exchanges TRA via Amendment No. 1 (which substituted a fixed Settlement Payment for the formula) paired with a standalone Termination and Release Agreement. Management disclosed the settlement at roughly 47% of its central $1.8B nominal future-payment estimate; the company recorded a $674.7M charge to 2020 operations. A June 2022 shareholder derivative suit alleging the settlement overpaid the TRA Parties remained pending as of the FY2025 10-K. See `contract_log.md` for the full termination instrument set and the litigation timeline.
